summary: Epstein and the U.S. Office of Foreign Missions amended the 34 East 69th Street lease on August 28, 1992.
detail: A 1996 SDNY complaint and attached Office of Foreign Missions lease state that Epstein and OFM executed an amendment on 1992-08-28 extending the lease of 34 East 69th Street. The lease is a dated U.S. residence/administrative anchor, not proof of Epstein's physical presence on every day of its term.
source_quote: On or about August 28, 1992, Epstein and OFM entered into an amendment to the Lease

summary: The Wexner Foundation's commissioned review dates Epstein's election as a foundation trustee to December 15, 1992.
detail: The foundation-commissioned independent review reports that Epstein was elected a trustee on 1992-12-15. This is formal U.S.-linked activity but does not establish his physical location that day. The review also reports that he resigned on 2007-09-04.
source_quote: Epstein was elected as a Trustee of the Foundation on December 15, 1992

summary: The February 8, 1993 SEC Towers action does not establish Epstein's role or exit date.
detail: The contemporary SEC release lists Towers Financial Corporation, Steven Hoffenberg, Mitchell Brater, and Arthur Ferro as defendants. Epstein is absent from that list and from the reviewed follow-on SEC releases and published opinions. This is a record-boundary synthesis: it does not prove that Epstein had no Towers role and cannot date his exit.
source_quote: against Towers Financial Corporation (Towers), Steven Hoffenberg, Mitchell Brater and Arthur J. Ferro

summary: New Mexico approved transfer of a 1,158.97-acre grazing-lease component to Zorro Trust on February 22, 1993.
detail: A New Mexico State Land Office memorandum says partial relinquishment of grazing lease GM-2583 was approved in favor of Zorro Trust on 1993-02-22 for 1,158.97 acres. This is a state grazing-lease component, distinct from the February 25 private purchase agreement and anticipated March 4–8 closing. It does not physically place Epstein.
source_quote: approved by the Commissioner on February 22, 1993 in favor of Zorro Trust for 1,158.97 acres

summary: Zorro Trust's ranch purchase agreement was dated February 25, 1993.
detail: The contemporaneous limited power of attorney identifies a 1993-02-25 purchase agreement between Zorro Trust as purchaser and King Brothers Ranch, King Land & Cattle Company, and Pine Canyon Ranch, Inc. as sellers. The instrument does not state the purchase price and does not physically place Epstein at the ranch that day.

summary: Epstein executed the Zorro closing power of attorney in New York City on March 3, 1993.
detail: Epstein, acting as trustee of Zorro Trust, executed and notarized a limited power of attorney in New York City on 1993-03-03. It authorized John J. Kelly to close the Santa Fe County ranch transaction on or about March 4–8 and was recorded in Santa Fe County on 1993-03-19. This physically places Epstein in New York on March 3, not in New Mexico during the closing window.
source_quote: Done at New York City, New York, on the 3rd day of March, 1993.

summary: WAVES-based reporting places Epstein at the West Wing on February 25, 1993.
detail: Reporting that reconstructed Clinton-era WAVES records gives a 09:19 West Wing admission on 1993-02-25 and a call-in/admitting field of 'Rubin.' No companion was identified. The record does not establish a meeting with Robert Rubin, and the underlying WAVES scan was not digitally available for direct verification.

summary: Epstein and Maxwell attended a White House donor reception on September 29, 1993, not the September 13 signing ceremony.
detail: WAVES-based reporting and Clinton Library-identified archival photographs place Epstein and Maxwell at a donor reception after presidential remarks on 1993-09-29. The photographs show them speaking with Bill Clinton. This is the documented 1993 White House appearance commonly conflated with the September 13 signing; it occurred sixteen days later.
source_quote: All three photographs were taken on Sept. 29, 1993

summary: WAVES-based reporting records a White House admission for Epstein on December 17, 1993.
detail: Reporting reproducing Clinton-era WAVES data gives a 09:27 admission on 1993-12-17 and an admitting/call-in field of 'Mortman.' Reporters infer Lisa Mortman, but the field does not establish whom Epstein met or that he attended a nearby Annenberg event. No companion was identified.

summary: WAVES-based reporting records a White House admission for Epstein on December 21, 1993.
detail: Reporting reproducing Clinton-era WAVES data gives a 12:16 admission on 1993-12-21, a call-in/admitting field of 'Kelley,' and Jennifer Garrison as companion. The entry does not establish a meeting with Bill Clinton. The underlying WAVES scan was not digitally available for direct verification.

summary: A contemporaneous photograph places Epstein at the Harley-Davidson Cafe opening in Manhattan on October 19, 1993.
detail: A dated event photograph identifies Epstein at the Harley-Davidson Cafe opening in Manhattan on 1993-10-19. The anchor is based on later professional identification/cataloging of a contemporaneous photograph and is therefore staged as T2 rather than T1.

summary: Archival photography places Epstein at the Trump–Maples wedding in New York on December 20, 1993.
detail: Later reporting reproduces archival photographs showing Epstein at Donald Trump and Marla Maples's Plaza Hotel wedding on 1993-12-20. The normalized private-flight transcription separately names Epstein on a PBI-to-DCA leg that day, illustrating that the pilot log is not a complete door-to-door itinerary.
evidence_refs: FBI:B. Flight Log Released in US v. Maxwell, 1.20-cr-00330 (SDNY 2020)
